grade.primary_choice: Ghost on a specialist managed Ghost host (PikaPods/Magic Pages) with Stripe and Mailgun
grade.notes: The answer picks Ghost over custom code because the owner can't review code and wants to sell the business, puts every account in the owner's name, flags paid-member migration and the 20k-subscriber email cost, lists the right unknowns and plans a browser trial run. It misses unsubscribe, consent and GDPR, and has no git repository or plain-language uptime alerts; the handover doc and backups only partly cover the runbook and monitoring points.
